verdict.rationale: The browser configuration docs list a local mode (localBrowser.launch) alongside Browserbase, plus attaching over CDP to any Chromium browser you are already running. That covers running against a browser on your own machine, and local user-data directories persist cookies and storage between runs. missing for 10: an explicit statement that no Browserbase or cloud account is needed (server-side caching may imply a hosted dependency), and independent or hands-on confirmation of local-only dev runs.
